mapIdentity.scope: The native ruins precinct and the three named survey nodes fix the north–south architectural sequence. Room dimensions, marble fragments and individual retaining lines are estimated.

note: Leiem’s two exact CC0 originals show the fractured central carved fountain screen and the stepped viewing dais with five stone panels. Government conservation records identify the white marble Yuanyingguan fragments and elevated base.
